I found Charlie dead in Security just now. My path this round was Oxygen, down to Upper Engine, then Medbay, Electrical, and finally Security. 

Early in the round, I saw Frank and Alice in Upper Engine around tick 3 or 4. Frank headed up to Oxygen, and Alice was still in Upper Engine when I left. Later on, around tick 7, I saw Diana in Medbay. 

I didn't see anyone passing through Electrical or going into Security before I found the body. Did anyone see Charlie earlier or notice someone heading towards the right side of the map? Let's hear where everyone was.

I can confirm Eve's timeline. I saw her pass through Medbay around tick 7 heading towards Electrical. 

Early in the round, around ticks 3 and 4, I was in Electrical and I saw Bob there. After Medbay, I moved to Upper Engine and then up to Oxygen to do a task, which is where I was when the meeting was called. I didn't see Charlie at all this round, nor did I see anyone heading over to the Security/Weapons side. 

Bob, you were in Electrical early on—did you see anyone pass through towards Security after I left? Let's hear from Frank and Alice too, since Eve saw them on the left side earlier.

Yeah, Diana and I were both in Electrical early, I can confirm that. I stayed there a bit, then went back up through Cafeteria and over to Weapons to do asteroids. I was in Weapons when the report got called.

I didn’t see Charlie at all this round, and I didn’t see anyone go through toward Security from Electrical while I was there. If Eve found the body in Security, then whoever did it probably came from the Security/Navigation side or slipped in after I left Electrical. I’d like to hear from Alice and Frank since they were on the left side early — especially where they went after Upper Engine/Oxygen.

I can confirm Eve's story about early on. I was in Upper Engine with Eve and Alice around ticks 3 and 4. After that, I headed up to Oxygen, and Alice was there with me around ticks 7 and 8. So Alice and I were on the far left side of the map for most of the round, giving us both a pretty solid alibi. There's no way either of us could have made it all the way to Security.

After Oxygen, I headed back down through Upper Engine and ended up in Medbay when the report was called. I didn't cross paths with Diana, but we might have just missed each other in the corridors.

Since Alice and I are mostly clear on the left, this really narrows it down to the right side. Bob, you said you went to Weapons, which is directly above Security. Eve, you found the body in Security. It seems highly likely that the killer is one of you two, or perhaps Charlie was killed right after Diana and Bob left Electrical. 

Alice, you speak next—please confirm we were together in Oxygen. For the vote, unless someone has a smoking gun against Bob or Eve, we might want to skip since it's hard to distinguish between the two right now, but I'm leaning towards being suspicious of Bob since Weapons is right next to the crime scene.

I can completely confirm Frank's timeline. We were together in Upper Engine early on with Eve, and then Frank and I were in Oxygen together around ticks 7 and 8. I saw him leave Oxygen heading south at tick 8, and I ended up in Cafeteria. Frank and I are definitely clear; neither of us could have made it to Security. 

I can also confirm Eve was with us in Upper Engine and left towards Medbay at tick 5. 

Since Frank and I are on the left side of the map, the killer is almost certainly someone on the right or center. Bob, you admit to being in Weapons, which is right next to Security. Eve, you found the body in Security. Either Bob slipped down to Security, or Eve is self-reporting. 

Given that it's 5 of us left and only 1 Duck, we shouldn't risk voting out an innocent on a 50/50 between Bob and Eve. A wrong vote here could be devastating. I strongly suggest we skip this round, stick together in groups of two or three, and see who acts suspiciously. I'm voting to skip.

Since Frank and Alice are vouching each other on the left and Diana has a pretty consistent route, I think forcing a vote on me or Eve with this little info is risky. I’m voting skip, then we group up next round and keep track of pairs.

I just found Alice dead in Storage. Listen closely because there are only three of us left: me, Eve, and Bob. That means this is do-or-die and we lose if we don't vote out the Duck right now. 

My route was Oxygen -> Cafeteria -> Electrical -> Security -> Navigation -> Storage. 

Eve, you are virtually cleared in my eyes. We crossed paths in Security around tick 23, then we were both in Navigation, and you just walked into Storage right behind me at tick 32 when I found Alice's body. There's no way you killed her in Storage while traveling with me from Nav.

That leaves Bob. I haven't seen Bob this entire round, giving him plenty of free time to kill both Diana and Alice while Eve and I were on the right side of the map. Bob, where exactly have you been? Eve, please confirm our movements — I'm highly confident Bob is our Duck.

Frank is right, our timelines match up perfectly. I saw Frank enter Security from Electrical around tick 23, and then we were both in Navigation for a bit before heading left. I followed him into Storage and that's exactly when he reported Alice's body. Since we were basically traveling together from the right side of the map, there's almost no way Frank could have killed Alice without me seeing it, unless he literally snapped her neck the exact second he walked into Storage and immediately self-reported. 

I haven't seen Bob at all recently. The last person I saw besides Frank was Diana in Medbay way back around tick 7. With Charlie, Diana, and Alice all dead, Bob, you have a lot of explaining to do. Where have you been this whole round? I'm firmly leaning towards voting Bob unless he can provide a perfect alibi, but I want to hear what he says first.

I’m not Duck. Frank, your “virtually cleared” logic is way too confident for final three.

My route was Nav -> Storage -> Medbay -> Upper Engine -> Oxygen -> Cafeteria -> Electrical -> Security -> Weapons. I saw Diana earlier in Electrical, Charlie in Security before the first body got reported, and Alice alive in Storage around mid-round. I finished up on the right side in Weapons doing asteroids when the report got called.

The key thing: Eve only clears that she was *following* Frank from Security/Nav. That does **not** clear Frank from killing Alice in Storage and instantly reporting as Eve came in behind him. In final three, a self-report is exactly what the Duck does if they have someone nearby to make it look clean.

Frank also immediately built the whole case as “Eve clear, Bob guilty” before I even spoke, which feels like he was trying to lock the vote before anyone could question the self-report. Eve, I get why you trust him, but you did not see Alice alive in Storage, and you did not see who killed her. If Frank entered first, he had the opportunity. My vote is Frank.

Eve, please slow down before locking this. Frank reporting does not clear him in final three — it’s the easiest way for Duck to control the story.

You two only started moving together around Security/Nav. That leaves the whole earlier round open. Frank’s route literally ends in Storage where Alice was found, and he got there first by his own admission. If he walks in first, kills, and reports as you come in, it looks exactly like what you’re describing: “clean report, Eve behind me.”

I was on a long route doing tasks and ended in Weapons. I wasn’t anywhere near Storage when the report happened. Frank immediately framed it as “Eve clear, Bob guilty” before hearing anything from me because he needs your vote locked. In final three, that’s the Duck play.

If you vote me, we lose. The only vote that makes sense is Frank.
